title: Homiliae in Psalmos, Codex Monacensis graecus 314 (Origen's 'new' Homilies on the Psalms) / «Гомилии на Псалмы» (Мюнхенский кодекс)
author: Origen of Alexandria
edition: Perrone et al., Die neuen Psalmenhomilien, GCS NF 19 (De Gruyter 2015), under copyright. Rights clearance or an own transcription of the Munich manuscript is needed.
ru_evidence: pravenc.ru 'Ориген' notes the 2015 publication but lists no Russian translation; azbyka.ru Origen page has no Psalm homilies; Labirint catalogue: none. Journal partials not excluded.
en_evidence: J. W. Trigg, Origen: Homilies on the Psalms, Codex Monacensis Graecus 314 (FOTC 141, CUA Press 2021), per Open Library
other_translations: GCS volume has German/Italian apparatus; other modern translations not verified
value: The most important patristic textual discovery in decades: 29 largely unknown Greek homilies by antiquity's most influential Christian scholar. Rich in Hexaplaric philology, Jewish exegesis and Origen's preaching voice in mid-3rd-century Caesarea. High visibility, and nothing exists in Russian.
ai_feasibility: high: homiletic Greek with simple syntax. Biblical and Hexaplaric variants must be tracked; source-text rights are the main obstacle.
pilot_unit: Homily on Ps 15 + four homilies on Ps 76; est. 18–22k words
